decisions.reason: Bosch 62825 is unscoped while the article specifies different OEM and tuned-car injector numbers and requires diagnostic selection and coding.
The unscoped Bosch 62825 claim does not prove the S55 injector index/application or the article's six-injector repair requirements.
The article primarily prescribes the oil-filter-housing gasket and makes the oil-cooler gasket conditional; the current claim is unscoped across N20 and B48.
DEP1038 is unscoped across a sixteen-year, multi-engine article and omits the separately prescribed thermostat.
VS50711 is unscoped across M54 and N52 applications and does not cover the article's additional VANOS O-ring branch.
VS50711 is unscoped across N20 and B48 generations, and exact application for this later X3 article is not established.
DEP1038 is unscoped across the article's unknown engines and incomplete without the prescribed thermostat.
The air-supply assembly is diagnosis- and VIN-conditional, but the current public claim has no enforceable fitment or completed EHC diagnosis gate.
The N62 transfer pipe is pressure-test- and VIN-conditional, while the current public claim has no machine-enforceable fitment or diagnosis gate.
Valve-stem seals are only one possible cause after formal oil-consumption diagnosis, yet the current claim is unscoped and immediately linkable.
This is a text-only, no-link warning that explicitly requires the ISTA elongation test and does not expose a retail product.
The gasket is conditional on leak-source and cover inspection, but the current public claim has no completed diagnosis gate or enforceable fitment.
The ATC700 motor is VIN- and VTG-diagnosis-dependent, while the current public link can render before those conditions are met.
DTF-1 service is only selected after the SIB tire, fault, and clutch-deactivation tests; the public claim has no diagnosis gate or vehicle scope.
The two-kit valve-seal repair is diagnosis- and VIN-conditional, while the current unscoped public claim can render before confirmation.
This is a recall-first, no-link dealer-remedy card that explicitly says not to buy a VANOS part first.
The N55 pump is ISTA- and VIN-conditional, but the current public claim lacks an enforceable completed-diagnosis gate.
The unscoped Gates 41236 claim spans both B48 and B58 while the article names different OEM pumps and requires a pump-and-thermostat repair bundle.
